title: Overachiever
description: 500+ Achievements, You're gonna need a bigger screen
body:
# 🏆 Overachiever

**501 new advancements across 16 themed tabs.** Across every corner of the game

Press `L`. Behold the wall of tabs. Despair. Begin.

## The tabs

| Tab | | Tab | |
|---|---|---|---|
| ⛏️ **Rock Bottom** | mining & caves | 🔥 **Highway to Hell** | the Nether |
| 🌾 **Old MacDonald** | farming & bees | 🐉 **Endgame** | the End |
| 🍗 **Om Nom Nom** | eating & regret | 🧠 **Big Brain Time** | redstone |
| 🐶 **Petting Zoo** | animals | 🚂 **Planes, Trains & Automobiles** | getting around |
| ⚔️ **Monster Mash** | combat | 🌊 **Ocean Man** | fishing & the deep |
| 🛡️ **Dressed to Kill** | gear & drip | 💰 **It Takes a Village** | trades & raids |
| ✨ **Abracadabra** | enchanting & brewing | 💀 **Hall of Shame** | dying, creatively |
| 🗺️ **Wanderlust** | biomes & structures | ⭐ **Overachiever** | secrets & memes |


## Features

- 🧾 **501 advancements**, from "punch a tree" to "kill every hostile mob in the game"
- 📊 **Stat-tracked long hauls**: walk a marathon, catch 500 fish, play 24 real hours
- 🏅 Challenge advancements grant XP; grinders are server-friendly
- 🧩 **Zero mods required**: pure vanilla datapack
- ✅ Never collides with vanilla advancement names; plays fine alongside them

## Compatability
Some Advancements may conflict with BACAP. im working on a version which has compatibilty with both. for now support is untested. here be dragons
